description: TypeScript CLI with a privileged release workflow, fake checks, and unbounded suppressions.

must_find.QUAL-02: no real tests, and the compiler runs with strict set to false
must_find.QUAL-03: lint ends with `|| exit 0`, so violations never fail
must_find.QUAL-05: tidy.ts disables ESLint for the whole file without a reason
must_find.DEP-01: no lockfile, and the Node version is not pinned for development
must_find.CI-02: actions are pinned to tags instead of commit SHAs
must_find.CI-03: no permissions block, and checkout persists credentials by default
must_find.CI-10: pull_request_target checks out the PR head and publishes with the npm token
must_find.SEC-02: the file path is interpolated into a shell command
must_find.DEL-01: published builds use `npm install` without a lockfile and skip validation
must_find.DEL-03: any pull request publishes a release without authorization or recorded changes

must_not_flag.STRUCT-02: fewer than 20 files in every directory
must_not_flag.OPS-01: a command-line tool, not a deployed service
must_not_flag.SEC-04: no public environment or debug interface
must_not_flag.TOOL-01: no tools, skills, or MCP servers configured
